reports.title: Castle Biosciences Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Castle Biosciences is raising its guidance for anticipated total revenue in 2026. The Company now anticipates generating between $385-395 million in total revenue in 2026, compared to the previously provided guidance of between $365-375 million. Further, the Company maintains its expectation to achieve positive Adjusted EBITDA for the fourth quarter 2026, the full year 2026 and the full year 2027.
